hints: Do the two halves separately: read the pre-order text into a tree, then write that tree out level by level.
Reading is a walk with a cursor: take the next token; if it is `#` the child is absent, otherwise make a node and read its left subtree and then its right one, in that order.
Because every absent child is written down, the reader never has to guess where a subtree ends - the `#`s mark every boundary, which is why this form can be read back at all.
Writing is the level queue, pushing both children of every real node including the absent ones, and trimming the `#`s off the end at the finish.
